summary.case_selection_rule: two slowest 2025 teams among teams with >=12 reference-qualified races; replace slower matched teammate if evidence exists
summary.point_coverage: 87 local races reconstructed; independent top3 spot check only; no claim of all-race independent official validation

methodology.scope: 2023–2026 local completed Race snapshots; case study full 2025 season, retrospective, not historical forecast
methodology.position: previous state within same session+driver; no fixed freshness limit; source age retained
methodology.stint_boundary: latest start attribution for bookkeeping; all multi-hit laps excluded from performance
methodology.normal_lap: positive <=300 sec, lap>1, not pit in/out or adjacent guard, source/DQ eligible, dry tyre and no measured rain, no reconstructed safety/red/yellow overlap
methodology.sc_margin: end notice is not green: exclude until second following driver lap start; missing end excludes through session end; strict variant adds one lap
methodology.field_reference: same race, compound, lap bin 5; >=4 distinct drivers and >=3 teams. Leave-driver-out reference. Age-bin 5 as sensitivity.
methodology.teammate_pair: same race, team, lap and compound; tyre age difference <=3; start time difference <=90sec; >=8 pairs per race
methodology.profile_eligibility: at least 8 races, 200 reference-matched laps; teammate metric requires 5 races; tyre needs 4 races and 8 valid stints
methodology.tyre_fit: at least 8 valid observations/stint and age range>=7; OLS raw sec/age plus field-relative sec/age. No physical wear/causal claim.
methodology.pit_counts: all started entries including zero, only source-present races; completed-only sensitivity; source-present does not prove complete
methodology.pit_benchmark: valid nonquarantined lane 0..180 sec, stop 0..10 sec, dry nonspecial race; race-relative median then equal-race aggregate; source counts kept
methodology.case_selection: 2025 full season; two slowest eligible teams on baseline race-relative pace, no former mockup or preset target/candidate
methodology.candidate_selection: all other-team eligible drivers; same-race relative pace vs replaced seat plus own-teammate evidence, no weighted sum or 100-point score
methodology.stability: 11 predefined settings, common-race comparison, race bootstrap 2000 draws fixed seed, leave-one-race-out, first/second calendar half, tyre/consistency diagnostics
methodology.interpretation: exploratory many-candidate screen; intervals not multiple-testing corrected; confirmation requires independent/held-out study; no transfer causality or income projection
methodology.missing_bronze_evidence: original API JSON, HTTP outcomes and collection timestamps cannot be reconstructed from CSV; do not invent them
methodology.replacement_seat_rule: Within each target team, larger matched-teammate delta (slower) if both seats have >=5 paired races; otherwise relative field pace with explicit caveat. Whole-season field order alone does not identify slower teammate.
